aboutSub: Master painters & decorators, East Maitland NSW.
aboutParas: Todd Lantry Master Painters & Decorators has been painting in the Hunter since 1991. It's a family owned and run business: Todd works alongside his father, Max, and has more than 25 years of painting experience.
All of our painters are full-time employees. We've been a Dulux Accredited Painter for over 10 years, are members of the MBA, and back all services with a 5-year warranty.
Call Todd on 0416 154 126 or email info@toddlantrypainting.com.au to talk about your job.
